persistent_systems: one governed PostgreSQL canonical evidence and proposal store
projections: ATIF v1.7 for explicitly mapped portable tasks/evals
architecture_decision.reason: the real OTel path and relational memory oracle pass without a second authority; current failures are labels, outcome validity, calibration, and prospective causality—not demonstrated vector scale

find_people_doing_similar_work.basis: the audited public histories have no stable user field and cannot be treated as an independent cross-user enterprise cohort
find_people_doing_similar_work.next_gate: authorized SWE-chat or consented enterprise same-task labels with cohort privacy

find_repeated_friction_and_later_recover.basis: one canonical constructor on Wisp and share-codex
find_repeated_friction_and_later_recover.next_gate: human outcome labels and prospective validation

fine_tune_enterprise_embeddings.basis: no frozen E2 hard slice or hybrid baseline comparison
fine_tune_enterprise_embeddings.next_gate: at least +5 absolute Recall@20 over the general hybrid baseline without RLS/deletion/latency regression

identify_missing_cloud_or_domain_skills.basis: CodeTrace/MAST labels describe trajectory events, not human capability
identify_missing_cloud_or_domain_skills.next_gate: reviewed capability taxonomy, environmental-availability labels, abstention, and prospective task uplift

recommend_collaboration.basis: trace similarity is not collaboration utility
recommend_collaboration.next_gate: reciprocal opt-in introductions and independently measured outcomes under minimum cohorts

show_each_user_all_currently_authorized_.basis: Wisp governed PostgreSQL pagination/denial plus seven public native-or-derived history fidelity audits

suggest_evals_from_traces.basis: Wisp evidence-linked proposals plus CodeTraceBench mutation mechanics
suggest_evals_from_traces.next_gate: guided harness/environment/verifier construction and changed-system execution

write_memory_or_memory_md.basis: Wisp correctly emitted zero fact proposals
write_memory_or_memory_md.next_gate: bitemporal contradiction benchmark, citations, review, rollback, and later-query utility

L0_evidence_conformance.blocking_gap: the pinned real collector path passed, but a wholly upstream-dropped trace requires an out-of-band source/export manifest; production storage/failover and ATIF's deliberate enterprise-event non-reversibility remain
L0_evidence_conformance.decision: keep one governed canonical DAG; ATIF and OTel remain receipted projections

L1_personal_authority.blocking_gap: permission-oracle equality across every surface, deletion closure, concurrent policy churn, restart, replica, and failover remain untested

L2_cheap_evidence_finding.decision: retain deterministic signals as review filters plus a random audit stratum; do not claim enrichment gate success

diagnosis.reason: the full deterministic factorial ran, but no evidence arm beat reverse chronology and irrelevant errors changed rankings; no calibrated judge or step-level causal verifier

multi_agent_taxonomy.reason: released human and judge partitions cannot reproduce finalized human-vs-judge accuracy

retrospective_eval.reason: high harmful-mutant sensitivity came with 48.6% benign false positives; no changed-system rerun or step-level causal verifier exists

L4_semantic_candidate_retrieval.decision: do not add or fine-tune an embedding model until a common labelled candidate-set comparison beats exact+FTS+structured

L5_temporal_memory.decision: copy-on-write correction, authority intersection, rollback, deletion closure, influence exclusion, and stale-epoch denial pass in a deterministic oracle; real research and paired trace/memory strata now exist, but PostgreSQL/RLS execution and natural-trace memory quality remain unproven

L6_procedural_replay.decision: AgentTrace supports loss-aware telemetry and bounded command comparison, not causal memory replay: task verdicts, expected state digests, seeds, and intervention arms are absent

L7_to_L10.decision: no utility routing, enterprise release, domain embedding adaptation, or generator fine-tuning claim is authorized

overall_status: real OTel conformance, governed history mechanics, and synthetic memory invariants pass; diagnosis, causal replay, cross-user learning, and prospective enterprise utility do not
